name: testsigma
description: Local marketplace for the Arcus Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: arcus
plugins.description: Guide a developer's agent through the Arcus CLI and the QI workflow: read an issue's cases from QI, write and check .sigma tests, run them on web or Android, push in direct or qi mode, pull, accept and verify.

plugins.name: arcus-jit
plugins.description: Catch a change before review, after Meta's just-in-time catching tests: run the story's tests on the change and its merge base on your own stack, have a fresh-session agent write tests that try to break it, have a judge subagent rule on what fails on the change alone, and record your fix-or-ship choice in one PR comment. Needs the arcus plugin and the Arcus CLI.
